tasks.label: port4000:show
args: $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $conns) { Write-Host 'No listener on 4000'; exit 0 }; $conns | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host

tasks.label: kill:port4000:force
args: $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $conns) { Write-Host 'No listener on 4000'; exit 0 }; $pids = $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($p in $pids) { Write-Host "Stopping PID $p on port 4000"; Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250; $left = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($left) { Write-Host 'Still listening on 4000:'; ($left | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; exit 1 } else { Write-Host 'Port 4000 is free.' }
